description: Figure 2 is a line plot that compares the performance of different chunking strategies in terms of the number of tokens used. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, ranging from 200 to 800, and the y-axis represents the performance score, ranging from 10 to 40. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different chunking strategy: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The Tutorials line starts at a score of 30 and ends at a score of 30, showing a steady trend.
